concepts.quote: An outlined square from 0.25 to 0.75, centred in the window. The point is outside the unit square
concepts.why: Applies the default unit-square mapping to this code's values: centre (0.5,0.5) with half-length 0.25 gives 0.25..0.75, and (256,256) falls outside the default range.
The answer says nothing about the double type or floating-point arithmetic.

concepts.quote: The point is outside the unit square so you do not see it.
concepts.why: Correctly describes the picture and explains why the point is invisible by relating StdDraw.point to the default coordinate system (unit square), rejecting the pixel-coordinate misconception; it diagnoses the given case but proposes no change or fix, so it stays at L3.
